title: Kayak Cruises Scraper
description: Browse Kayak cruise sailings with ship, departure port, trip length, itinerary, fare, currency, and region. Batch ocean or river product types and sort offers.

batch.title: Cruise types
batch.description: KAYAK cruise product types to retrieve, such as ocean or river sailings.
batch.valueDescription: Product Type used to run this search.

schema.description: Minimum number of nights for returned cruise sailings.
Number of adult travelers included in the search.
Number of children traveling on the cruise search.
Sort order for returned search results. Accepted values: recommended, price, duration, departuredate.
Direction used for the selected result sort. Accepted values: asc, desc.
Cruise product category, such as ocean or river. Accepted values: ocean, river.
Whether to include offers marked as cruise deals.
Whether to include sailings marked unavailable.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Scrape Kayak cruise sailings with ships, departure ports, itineraries, trip lengths, fares, and regions. Compare ocean or river cruise options.
storeCopy.intro: Browse Kayak cruise sailings with ship names, departure ports, trip lengths, itineraries, fares, and regions. Request ocean or river product types in one run.
useCases: Cruise planners can compare sailings by ship, port, length, and fare.
Travel analysts can monitor cruise inventory across regions.
Travel agencies can build sailing shortlists for customer itineraries.
howToUse: Add `ocean` or `river` to each entry in `sailing_types`.
Set passenger count, minimum nights, page, and sort preferences.

faqs.question: Can I restrict sailings to a departure port?
faqs.answer: The available search filters do not include a departure-port input. Returned rows include the port when KAYAK supplies it.

fields.name: id

fields.name: name

fields.name: currency

fields.name: currencySymbol
fields.description: Currency symbol displayed with the fare.

fields.name: departurePort
fields.description: Port where the cruise itinerary begins.
